sources.title: elrashid/sae-gemma-2-9b-it-topk-l21 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A TopK sparse autoencoder for google/gemma-2-9b-it, residual-stream layer 21 (d_in=3584, d_sae=57344, k=64, FVU=0.4772). Trained with the v2 recipe (BOS-drop + per-dim standardization) for The Refusal Slope: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Feature Fate in Quantized Edge Intelligence (M. Elrashid, BUiD).

sources.title: elrashid/gate-gemma-2-9b-it-l21 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A SAE safety gate for google/gemma-2-9b-it: logistic regression over sparse-autoencoder features of the layer-21 residual stream, returning P (harmful) from the prompt before the first output token.
